name: Dice
description: Dice faces showing one to six, tossed a little askew in rows: colored cubes with their pips picked out in a second ink.

code.style: --rule: ( --z0: @r(1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --pips: @p(@var(--f1), @var(--f2), @var(--f3), @var(--f4), @var(--f5), @var(--f6)); transform: translate(@r(-5%, 5%), @r(-5%, 5%)) rotate(@r(-16deg, 16deg)) scale(.78); border-radius: 18%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--pips); mask: @var(--pips); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --f1: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 50% 50% / 15% 15% no-repeat; --f2: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 22.94% 22.94% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 77.06% 77.06% / 15% 15% no-repeat; --f3: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 22.94% 22.94% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 50% 50% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 77.06% 77.06% / 15% 15% no-repeat; --f4: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 22.94% 22.94% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 77.06% 22.94% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 22.94% 77.06% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 77.06% 77.06% / 15% 15% no-repeat; --f5: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 22.94% 22.94% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 77.06% 22.94% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 50% 50% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 22.94% 77.06% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 77.06% 77.06% / 15% 15% no-repeat; --f6: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 22.94% 22.94% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 77.06% 22.94% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 22.94% 50% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 77.06% 50% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 22.94% 77.06% / 15% 15% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 77.06% 77.06% / 15% 15% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
